newsitem.title: UK: TREG proposes C shares for KEPIT investors.
newsitem.headline: TREG proposes C shares for KEPIT investors.

text.p: TR European Growth Trust (TREG) said it proposed an issue of conversion shares for Kleinwort European Privatisation Trust (KEPIT) investors choosing cash to exit the investment fund.
Earlier this month, TREG gave up its hostile bid for the 500 million stg KEPIT.

"The C share issue will provide an opportunity for investors, shareholders and warrantholders of...KEPIT, who choose to elect for cash under their board's proposals, to participate in TREG's excellent and consistent performance," TREG said in a statement.
The shares will convert into new ordinary shares.

TREG, whose offer will be open for three weeks from mid-November, also proposed making a bonus issue of warrants to both the subscribers for the C shares and exisiting holders of TREG ordinary shares and participating subscription shares.

KEPIT has offered its investors the chance to invest in a contuning European privatisation unit trust, a general Europe unit trust managed by M&G or a cash exit via a Kleinwort Benson money market fund.
TREG bid, which lapsed earlier this month, received acceptances equivalent to 3.04 percent of ordinary KEPIT shares.
